classification.difficultyReason: The gradient is derived from the two intercepts, and the negative gradient needs the 180° adjustment.

content.prompt: A line has $x$-intercept $-5$ and $y$-intercept $-2$. Sketch the line, then find its angle of inclination to the nearest degree.

answer.short: $\theta\approx158^\circ$. The line passes through $(-5,0)$ and $(0,-2)$, so $m=-\dfrac25$ and $\theta=\tan^{-1}\!\left(-\dfrac25\right)+180^\circ$.
answer.worked:
The line passes through $(-5,0)$ and $(0,-2)$.
$$\begin{align*}m&=\frac{-2-0}{0-(-5)}\\m&=-\frac25\end{align*}$$
Draw the line through $(-5,0)$ and $(0,-2)$. The inverse tangent is negative, so add $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\tan\theta&=-\frac25\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\!\left(-\frac25\right)+180^\circ\\\theta&\approx158^\circ\end{align*}$$
